title: Two New Private Spacecraft Launch to the Moon
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Two private spacecraft are on their way to the moon to carry out separate missions .
sentences.zh: 两艘私人航天器正在前往月球的途中执行不同的飞行任务。

sentences.en: The landers launched January 15 from the American government’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
sentences.zh: 登陆者从美国政府位于佛罗里达的肯尼迪航天中心 发射1月15号

sentences.en: The private company SpaceX used its Falcon 9 launch vehicle to fly the landers into space.
sentences.zh: 私营公司SpaceX利用Falcon 9运载火箭将着陆器送入太空。

sentences.en: The two separated from Falcon 9 about one hour into the flight.
sentences.zh: 两人从猎鹰9号起飞 大约一小时后起飞

sentences.en: Mission leaders said the launch went exactly as planned, with no problems reported.
sentences.zh: 特派团领导人说,发射工作完全按计划进行,没有出现任何问题。

sentences.en: The trip to the moon will take some time.
sentences.zh: 月球之旅需要一些时间

sentences.en: One spacecraft is expected to land on the lunar surface in early March, while the other should touch down in late May or early June.
sentences.zh: 一个航天器预计将在3月初降落在月球表面,另一个应在5月底或6月初着陆。

sentences.en: In February 2024, the first private spacecraft completed the first U.S. moon landing in more than 50 years.
sentences.zh: 2024年2月,第一艘私人航天器 完成了美国50多年来第一次登月

sentences.en: The lander, called Odysseus, was developed by the Texas-based company Intuitive Machines.
sentences.zh: 登陆者叫奥德修斯 是德州直觉机器公司开发的

sentences.en: The spacecraft experienced some technical problems but was able to carry out several science experiments before powering down permanently on the moon in late March.
sentences.zh: 该航天器遇到了一些技术问题,但在3月下旬在月球上永久停电之前,能够进行若干科学实验。

sentences.en: For this current mission, Texas-based Firefly Aerospace developed Blue Ghost, one of the two landers launched.
sentences.zh: 为完成目前的任务,位于得克萨斯州的Firefly航空航天公司开发了蓝鬼号,这是发射的两艘登陆艇之一。

sentences.en: The other, named Resilience, belongs to Japanese company ispace.
sentences.zh: 另一个叫"复原力" 属于日本的Ispace公司

sentences.en: Both are designed to collect data and materials to support several planned moon missions – some including astronauts – in coming years.
sentences.zh: 两者都旨在收集数据和材料,以支持未来几年计划中的若干月任务,有些包括宇航员。

sentences.en: The Blue Ghost lander is targeting a landing site near a volcanic structure called Mons Latreille.
sentences.zh: 蓝鬼登陆艇正在瞄准一个着陆场 靠近一个叫做蒙斯·拉特里耶的火山结构

sentences.en: It is a 480-kilometer basin that sits in the northeast quarter of the near side of the moon.
sentences.zh: 这是一个480公里的盆地, 位于月球的近侧东北地区。

sentences.en: The American space agency NASA says the 2-meter-tall Blue Ghost is carrying 10 NASA science and technology instruments.
sentences.zh: 美国太空总署说 2米长的蓝鬼 携带了10个美国航天局科技仪器

sentences.en: They aim to “gather valuable scientific data studying Earth’s nearest neighbor,” the agency said.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是“收集宝贵的科学数据,

sentences.en: NASA’s Artemis program aims to send astronauts to the moon for the first time since the Apollo 17 mission in 1972.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局的阿耳特弥斯计划旨在自1972年阿波罗17号任务以来首次向月球派遣宇航员。

sentences.en: The next planned flight in that program is Artemis II , which is set to launch in April 2026.
sentences.zh: 该方案的下一个计划飞行是阿耳特弥斯二号,定于2026年4月发射。

sentences.en: In that mission, four astronauts will fly NASA’s Orion spacecraft more than 400,000 kilometers on a trip around the moon.
sentences.zh: 在这次飞行任务中,四位宇航员将驾驶美国航天局的猎户座飞船绕月飞行40多万公里。

sentences.en: Nicola Fox is the associate administrator for NASA’s Science Mission Directorate in Washington D.C.
sentences.zh: Nicola Fox是美国航天局驻华盛顿特区科学任务局的副局长。

sentences.en: She said in a statement the agency’s cooperation with private companies is “a critical part of bringing humanity back to the moon.”
sentences.zh: 她在发言中说,该机构与私营公司的合作是 " 将人类带回月球的一个关键部分。

sentences.en: Fox added that NASA chose the new experiments partly because of information learned from NASA’s Apollo space program, which began in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: Fox补充说,美国航天局之所以选择新的实验,部分是因为从美国航天局从1960年代开始的阿波罗空间计划中获得了信息。

sentences.en: She said the current mission seeks to ensure “the safety and health of our future science instruments, spacecraft, and, most importantly, our astronauts on the lunar surface.”
sentences.zh: 她说,目前的飞行任务力求确保“我们未来的科学仪器、航天器以及最重要的是我们的月球表面宇航员的安全和健康。”

sentences.en: Blue Ghost’s equipment includes a tool to collect dirt and another to dig a hole for measuring temperatures below the lunar surface.
sentences.zh: 蓝鬼的设备包括收集泥土的工具和挖洞测量月球表面以下温度的工具。

sentences.en: The spacecraft is also carrying a device built to measure light reflections to be used with lasers to better measure the distance between Earth and the moon.
sentences.zh: 该航天器还携带一个装置,用来测量光反射,用激光更好地测量地球与月球之间的距离。

sentences.en: In addition, Blue Ghost is carrying instruments to examine the structure and density of areas beneath the lunar surface.
sentences.zh: 此外, " 蓝鬼 " 携带仪器,检查月球表面以下地区的结构和密度。

sentences.en: Other equipment will seek to capture X-ray images of the edge of Earth’s magnetic field.
sentences.zh: 其他设备将设法捕捉地球磁场边缘的X射线图像。

sentences.en: The ispace lander Resilience is carrying an exploring vehicle, called a rover, to the moon.
sentences.zh: 太空着陆器的恢复力 正在携带一个探索的飞行器, 叫做越野车, 飞往月球。

sentences.en: The five-kilogram rover is designed to collect lunar soil and other materials from the surface.
sentences.zh: 5公斤路虎的设计是为了从表面收集月球土壤和其他材料。

sentences.en: Resilience is also carrying equipment and instruments to complete several experiments for Japanese companies and other organizations.
sentences.zh: 复原力还携带设备和仪器,为日本公司和其他组织完成若干试验。

sentences.en: One of the experiments will test an electrolysis device designed to separate water into hydrogen and oxygen.
sentences.zh: 其中一项实验将试验一个电解装置,将水分解成氢和氧。

sentences.en: Such a device could help future astronauts better use water resources on the moon and produce rocket fuel.
sentences.zh: 这种装置可以帮助未来的宇航员更好地利用月球上的水资源并生产火箭燃料。

sentences.en: Other experiments set for the Resilience mission include food production tests and the deployment of a “deep space radiation probe.” The instrument is designed to collect detailed measurements of ionizing radiation in space.
sentences.zh: 为 " 复原力 " 飞行任务设定的其他实验包括食品生产试验和部署 " 深空辐射探测器 " 。 该仪器旨在收集空间电离辐射的详细测量数据。

sentences.en: NASA has said it is paying $101 million to Firefly for the mission and another $44 million for the experiments.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局说,它向Firefly公司支付1.01亿美元,用于执行这项任务,另外4 400万美元用于实验。

sentences.en: Officials from ispace did not report how much its mission would cost.
sentences.zh: 来自Ispace的官员没有报告其任务将花费多少费用。

sentences.en: It is the second moon mission for ispace.
sentences.zh: 这是空间号的第二个月亮任务。

sentences.en: During the last one, Japan’s space agency JAXA successfully launched its SLIM spacecraft to the moon in January 2024.
sentences.zh: 在上一个阶段,日本宇宙航空研究开发机构于2024年1月成功地向月球发射了其SLIM航天器。

sentences.en: But the lander touched down imperfectly, causing some communication and power problems.
sentences.zh: 但着陆器的碰撞不完美 造成了一些通讯和电力问题

sentences.en: However, Japanese space officials reported they had stayed in communication with SLIM through late April.
sentences.zh: 但是,日本空间官员报告说,他们与SLIM的通信一直持续到4月底。

sentences.en: During this time, they said the spacecraft was able to collect valuable data about the landing and surrounding area.
sentences.zh: 在此期间,他们说航天器能够收集关于着陆和周围地区的宝贵数据。

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn. Bryan Lynn wrote this story for VOA Learning English, based on reports from NASA, The Associated Press and Agence France-Press
sentences.zh: 我是Bryan Lynn。Bryan Lynn根据美国航天局、美联社和法国新闻社的报告,为VOA学习英语撰写了这个故事。
